40011994.author: पदार्थः
40011994.content: हरियूथपः vanara leader, हनुमान् Hanuman, विमानात् from the aerial chariot, प्राकारम् boundary wall, सुसम्क्रम्य jumped, घनान्तरे in the clouds, विद्युत् यथा like the lightning, वेगवान् speedily, आसीत् appeared.

40011994.author: Translation
40011994.content: Hanuman, the vanara leader, jumped from the aerial chariot to the boundary wall like a flash of lightning in the clouds.

40011995.author: पदार्थः
40011995.content: कपिः vanara, हनुमान् Hanuman, रावणस्य Ravana's, निवेशनात् from the home, सम्परिक्रम्य going round, जानकीम् Janaka's daughter, सीताम् Sita, अदृष्ट्वा not seeing, वचनम् these words, अब्रवीत् spoke.

40011995.author: Translation
40011995.content: Going round the palace of Ravana, unable to see Janaka's daughter Sita, Hanuman spoke thus to himself:

40011996.author: पदार्थः
40011996.content: रामस्य Rama's, प्रियम् to please, चरता while doing, लङ्का Lanka, भूयिष्ठम् in and out, लोलिता checked thoroughly, सर्वाङ्गशोभनाम् of beautiful limbs, वैदेहीम् Vaidehi, सीताम् Sita, न हि पश्यामि I have not seen.

40011996.author: Translation
40011996.content: "I have thoroughly surveyed the entire city of Lanka to please Rama, but I am unable to find Sita of flawless beauty.

40011997.author: पदार्थः
40011997.content: पल्वलानि waterlogs, तटाकानि tanks, सरांसि lakes, तथा similarly, सरितः streams, नद्यः rivers, अनूपवनान्ताश्च along the woods, दुर्गाः difficult places to reach, धरणीधराः mountains, सर्वा: all, वसुधा over the land, लोलिता searched, जानकीं तु but Janaki, न पश्यामि I have not seen.

40011997.author: Translation
40011997.content: "I have searched for Sita thoroughly in waterlogs, lakes, tanks, streams and rivers and all over the woods and among mountains that are difficult to reach. I have searched all over the land but have not been able to find Janaki.

40011998.author: पदार्थः
40011998.content: सीता Sita, इह here, रावणस्य Ravana's, निवेशने in his palace, गृध्रराजेन by the king of vultures, सम्पातिना by Sampati, आख्याता has told, अहम् I, ताम् her, न च पश्यामि but have not seen her.

40011998.author: Translation
40011998.content: "Sampati, king of vultures had said that Sita is at Ravana's palace. But I have not been able to see her.

40011999.author: पदार्थः
40011999.content: अथ now, वैदेही princess of Videha, मैथिली Mythili, जनकत्माजा Janaka's daughter, सीता Sita, विवशा dejected helpless, दुष्टचारिणम् a man of evilconduct, रावणम् to Ravana, किं नु उपतिष्ठेत  did she succumb?

40011999.author: Translation
40011999.content: "Can it be that Mythili, daughter of Janaka, dejected and helpless succumbed to the evil intentions of Ravana.

40012000.author: पदार्थः
40012000.content: रामबाणानाम् of the arrows of Rama, बिभ्यतः out of fear, रक्षसः the demon, सीताम् Sita, आदाय having brought, क्षिप्रम् at great speed, उत्पततः while flying, अन्तरा in the middle, पतिता dropped, भवेत् may be, मन्ये I think.

40012000.author: Translation
40012000.content: "Or, perhaps she might have been dropped midway from the hold of Ravana while he was flying at great speed, afraid of the deadly arrows of Rama?

40012001.author: पदार्थः
40012001.content: अथवा or else, सिद्धनिषेविते frequented by siddhas, पथि on the path, ह्रियमाणायाः while being borne away, आर्यायाः of the noble lady, हृदयम् heart, सागरम् sea, प्रेक्ष्य on seeing, पतितम् fallen, मन्ये I think.

40012001.author: Translation
40012001.content: "Or, perhaps while being borne away on the path frequented by siddhas, the beloved of Rama might have fallen down (dead), heart broken, on seeing the (vast) sea.

40012002.author: पदार्थः
40012002.content: रावणस्य Ravana's, उरुवेगेन by the high speed in the flight, भुजाभ्याम् with the arms, पीडितेन च being under pressure, विशालाक्ष्या by the largeeyed one, तया by her, आर्यया by the noble lady, जीवितम् life, त्यक्तम् given up, मन्ये I think.

40012002.author: Translation
40012002.content: "He thinks, on account of the high speed during the flight of Ravana under the pressure of his arms, the noble, largeeyed lady might have given up her life.

40012003.author: पदार्थः
40012003.content: तदा then, सागरम् उपर्युपरि higher and higher over the sea, क्रमतः for him while he advanced, जनकात्मजा Janaki, विवेष्टमाना wriggling hard to extricate, सागरे in the sea, नूनम् surely, पतिता fallen.

40012003.author: Translation
40012003.content: "Surely, she might have fallen into the sea while wriggling in her effort to extricate herself from the hold of Ravana as he was flying over the sea.

40012004.author: पदार्थः
40012004.content: अहो Oh, आत्मनः of her self, शीलम् chastity, रक्षन्ती while protecting, अबन्धुः distanced from relatives, तपस्विनी a helpless woman, सीता Sita, क्षुद्रेण by the cruel one, अनेन by him, रावणेन by Ravana, भक्षिता eaten.

40012004.author: Translation
40012004.content: "Oh poor Sita, distanced from relations, while protecting her chastity helplessly she might have been devoured by cruel Ravana.

40012005.author: पदार्थः
40012005.content: अथवा or else, अदुष्टा a pious lady, असितेक्षणा blackeyed one, सा that, दुष्टभावाभिः by the cruelnatured, राक्षसेन्द्रस्य of the lord of rakshasas, पत्नीभिः by wives also, भक्षिता eaten, भविष्यति I think.

40012005.author: Translation
40012005.content: "Or else, the pious, blackeyed Sita might have been eaten by the the cruelnatured wives of the lord of demons.

40012006.author: पदार्थः
40012006.content: कृपणा poor lady, सम्पूर्णचन्द्रप्रतिमम् like the fullmoon, पद्मपत्रनिभेक्षणम् with eyes like lotus petals, रामस्य Rama's, वक्त्रम् face, ध्यायती meditating on, पञ्चत्वम् death, गता attained.

40012006.author: Translation
40012006.content: "Or, she might have attained death, meditating on Rama, whose face resembles the fullmoon and eyes the lotus petals.

40012007.author: पदार्थः
40012007.content: वैदेही Vaidehi, मैथिली Mythili, हा राम Alas, Rama, हा लक्ष्मण alas, Lakshmana, हा अयोध्या alas, Ayodhya, इति thus, बहु very much, विलप्य weaping, न्यस्तदेहा cast off life, भविष्यति may be.

40012007.author: Translation
40012007.content: "Or, Vaidehi, the princess of Mithila might have cast off her life grieving intensely and crying, 'Alas, Rama, alas, Lakshmana, alas, Ayodhya'. (Mithila is the name of the  capital city and Videha is the country which was ruled by Janaka. Sita, the princess is known as Vaidehi, Mythili and Janaki).

40012008.author: पदार्थः
40012008.content: अथवा or else, रावणस्य Ravana's, निवेशने in his palace, निहिता kept, सीता Sita, पञ्जरस्था in the cage, शारिका इव like myna, नूनम् surely, लालप्यते crying, मन्ये I think.

40012008.author: Translation
40012008.content: "Or, I think Sita might have been imprisoned in a cage like a myna in Ravana's palace. She will be surely crying.

40012009.author: पदार्थः
40012009.content: जनकस्य Janaka's, सुता daughter, रामपत्नी Rama's wife, सुमध्यमा a lady of beautiful waist, उत्पलपत्राक्षी eyes like lotus petals, सीता Sita, रावणस्य Ravana's, वशम् fold, कथम् how, व्रजेत् can come under.

40012009.author: Translation
40012009.content: "How could Janaki, the daughter of Janaka, Rama's wife, the lady with a beautiful waist and eyes like lotus petals, come under the fold of Ravana?

40012010.author: पदार्थः
40012010.content: जनकात्मजा Janaka's daughter, विनष्टा वा whether lost, प्रणष्टा वा or whether irretrievable, मृता वा or dead, प्रियभार्यस्य for him who is fond of his wife, रामस्य of Rama, निवेदयितुम् to report, न क्षमम् not proper.

40012010.author: Translation
40012010.content: "Whether Janaki is lost or irretrievable or dead is not known The news should not be  reported to Rama, who is very fond of his wife.

40012011.author: पदार्थः
40012011.content: निवेद्यमाने by informing this, दोषः mistake, स्यात् may be, अनिवेदने by not informing, दोषः mistake, स्यात् may be, कथम् how, कर्तव्यं नु खलु what to do, मे to me, विषमम् difficult, प्रतिभाति appears.

40012011.author: Translation
40012011.content: "To carry or not to carry this news to Rama would be a mistake. What shall I do? I am facing a tough situation.

40012012.author: पदार्थः
40012012.content: अस्मिन् in this, कार्ये in this regard, एवं गते when things took such a turn, प्राप्तकालम् right time, क्षमम् proper, किम् what, भवेत् will be, इति thus, मतम् opinion, हनुमान् Hanuman, भूयः once again, प्रविचारयत् deliberated.

40012012.author: Translation
40012012.content: "I wonder what the right course of action is when things have taken such a turn? What is proper for me to do? Hanuman once again deliberated.

40012013.author: पदार्थः
40012013.content: अहम् I, सीताम् Sita, अदृष्ट्वा without seeing, इतः from here, वानरेन्द्रपुरीम् city of vanaras, गमिष्यामि I reach, यदि if, ततः then, कः what (has been accomplished), पुरुषार्थः accomplishment, भविष्यति will happen.

40012013.author: Translation
40012013.content: "If I return to Kishkinda without seeing Sita of what use is my effort? What have I accomplished? What will happen? (Dharma, Artha, Kama and Moksha are the four Purusharthas or accomplishments in life)

40012014.author: पदार्थः
40012014.content: मम my, इदम् this, सागरस्य of the ocean, लङ्घनम् crossing, लङ्कायाः of Lanka, प्रवेशश्च entry, राक्षसानाम् of ogres, दर्शनम् seeing, व्यर्थम् futile, भविष्यति would be.

40012014.author: Translation
40012014.content: "My crossing the ocean, my entry into Lanka and my survey of the demons are all futile.

40012015.author: पदार्थः
40012015.content: किष्किन्धाम् at Kishkinda, समनुप्राप्तम् reached, माम् to me, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, किम् what, वक्ष्यति he says, समागताः collected, हरयः वा even vanaras, तौ those two, दशरथात्मजौ वा sons of Dasaratha.

40012015.author: Translation
40012015.content: "What will Sugriva or even the vanaras and the two sons of Dasaratha say when I reach Kishkinda?

40012016.author: पदार्थः
40012016.content: गत्वा after reaching, काकुत्स्थम् Kakutstha, मया by me, सीता Sita, न दृष्टा not seen, इति like this, परम् most, अप्रियम् unpleasant, वक्ष्यामि यदि if I say, ततः then, जीवितम् life, त्यक्ष्यति he will give up.

40012016.author: Translation
40012016.content: "If I report the most unpleasant news that Sita was not found, Rama will give up his life.

40012017.author: पदार्थः
40012017.content: परुषम् harsh, दारुणम् dreadful, क्रूरम् cruel, तीक्ष्णम् sharp, इन्द्रियतापनम् that which can scorch senses, सीतानिमित्तम् about Sita, दुर्वाक्यम् unwelcome words, श्रुत्वा after hearing, सः Rama, न भविष्यति will not live.

40012017.author: Translation
40012017.content: Hearing harsh, dreadful, cruel and sense-scorching evil tidings about Sita, Rama will not survive.

40012018.author: पदार्थः
40012018.content: कृच्छ्रगतम्  in painful state, पञ्चत्वगतमानसम् one who has almost given his life, तम् him, दृष्ट्वा seeing, भृशानुरक्तः deeply devoted, मेधावी wise, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, न भविष्यति will not survive.

40012018.author: Translation
40012018.content: "Seeing Rama in such a painful state, wise Lakshmana who has given his life to Rama, to whom he is deeply devoted will also not survive.

40012019.author: पदार्थः
40012019.content: भ्रातरौ both brothers, विनष्टौ dead, श्रुत्वा after hearing, भरतोऽपि Bharata also, मरिष्यति will die, मृतम् dead, भरतम् of Bharata, दृष्ट्वा on seeing, शत्रुघ्नश्च even Satrughna, न भविष्यति will not live.

40012019.author: Translation
40012019.content: "On hearing the death of both the brothers Bharata will also die. On seeing this Satrughna will also not live.

40012020.author: पदार्थः
40012020.content: अथ then, मातरः mothers, कौसल्या च and Kausalya, सुमित्रा च even Sumitra, कैकेयी च even Kaikeyi, पुत्रान् of sons, मृतान् of their death, समीक्ष्य on seeing, न भविष्यन्ति will not be able to live, संशयः न no doubt.

40012020.author: Translation
40012020.content: Seeing their sons dead, the mothers Kausalya, Sumitra and Kaikeyi will surely not survive—there is no doubt.

40012021.author: पदार्थः
40012021.content: कृतज्ञः grateful, सत्यसन्धः truthful, प्लवगाधिपः leader of monkeys, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, तथा likewise, गतम् gone, रामम् Rama, दृष्ट्वा on seeing, ततः then, जीवितम् life, त्यक्ष्यति will give up.

40012021.author: Translation
40012021.content: "On seeing that Rama has ended his life, the grateful and truthful monkey leader, Sugriva will give up his life.

40012022.author: पदार्थः
40012022.content: भर्तृशोकेन on account of her husband's grief, पीडिता tormented, दुर्मनाः disheartened, व्यथिता pained, दीना dejected, निरानन्दा unhappy, तपस्विनी helpless, रुमा Ruma, जीवितम् life, त्यक्ष्यति will give up.

40012022.author: Translation
40012022.content: "Distressed, disheartened, pained and grieved on account of her husband's death, the virtuous lady Ruma (wife of Sugriva) will be unhappy and die.

40012023.author: पदार्थः
40012023.content: वालिजेन caused by Vali, दुःखेन by sorrow, पीडिता troubled, शोककर्शिता fertured with grief, तारापि Tara too, राज्ञि when the king, पञ्चत्वम् gone to other world, गते having gone, न भविष्यति will not live

40012023.author: Translation
40012023.content: "Tara who is troubled by Vali's death and tortured with grief will not live when king Sugriva dies.

40012024.author: पदार्थः
40012024.content: कुमारः prince, अङ्गदोऽपि Angada also, मातापित्रोः of his mother and father, विनाशेन by death, सुग्रीवस्य Sugriva's, व्यसनेन by calamity, जीवितम् life, कस्मात् why, धारयिष्यति will retain.

40012024.author: Translation
40012024.content: "On account of his parents death and also because of Sugriva's calamity, Angada will give up his life.

40012025.author: पदार्थः
40012025.content: नौकसः vanaras, भर्तृजेन on account of the events affecting their king, दुःखेन by grief, अभिभूताः overpowered, तलैः with their palms, मुष्टिभिरेव च and with their fists, शिरांसि their heads, अभिहनिष्यन्ति will hit themselves.

40012025.author: Translation
40012025.content: "The grief due to the death of their king will make the vanaras hit their heads with their palms and fists.

40012026.author: पदार्थः
40012026.content: यशस्स्विना by the illustrious one, कपिराजेन by the king of vanaras, सान्त्वेन by good words, अनुप्रदानेन by offering gifts, मानेन by respecting, लालिताः reared, वानराः vanaras, प्राणान् life, त्यक्ष्यन्ति will give up.

40012026.author: Translation
40012026.content: "The vanaras who were reared by the king's kind words, gifts and care will give up their life.

40012027.author: पदार्थः
40012027.content: कपिकुञ्जराः chiefs among vanaras, समेत्य collected together, वनेषु in the forest, क्रीडाम् play, न अनुभविष्यन्ति will not enjoy, शैलेषु on the mountains, न निरोधेषु वा or in the caves, पुनः again, न not.

40012027.author: Translation
40012027.content: "The chiefs among vanaras together will not enjoy their life in the forest or mountains or caves.

40012028.author: पदार्थः
40012028.content: सपुत्रदाराः with sons and wives, सामात्याः with ministers together, भर्तृव्यसनपीडिताः tormented by the suffering of their king's death, शैलाग्रेभ्यः from the mountain peaks, समेषु on the plains, विषमेषु च and on uneven grounds, पतिष्यन्ति will fall (drop down).

40012028.author: Translation
40012028.content: "Tormented by their king's death the vanaras with their wives, sons and ministers will drop down from the mountain peaks on the rough ground and die.

40012029.author: पदार्थः
40012029.content: वानराः vanaras, विषम् poison, उद्बन्धनं वापि or by hanging, ज्वलनस्य in the fire, प्रवेशं वा entering, उपवासम् by fasting, अथो or, शस्त्रम् weapon, प्रचरिष्यन्ति they will use to put an end.

40012029.author: Translation
40012029.content: "The vanaras will put an end to their lives by poisoning or by hanging or by selfimmolation or by killing themselves with weapons or by fasting unto death.

40012030.author: पदार्थः
40012030.content: मयि गते when I go, इक्ष्वाकुकुलनाशश्च destruction of the Ikshvakus, वनौकसाम् of vanaras, नाशश्चैव destruction, घोरम् dreadful, आरोदनम् weeping, भविष्यति will be, मन्ये I think.

40012030.author: Translation
40012030.content: "If I go there (without finding Sita), it will cause destruction of the Ikshvakus and vanaras would weep. It would be dreadful.

40012031.author: पदार्थः
40012031.content: अहम् I, इतः from here, किष्किन्धां नगरीम् to the city of Kishkinda, नैव गमिष्यामि I will not go, अहम् I, मैथिलीं Mythili, विना without, सुग्रीवम् Sugriva, द्रष्टुम् to see, न च शक्ष्यामि not possible for me.

40012031.author: Translation
40012031.content: "I will not go to the city of Kishkinda from here or to Sugriva without finding Mythili. It will not be possible for me to face him.

40012032.author: पदार्थः
40012032.content: मयि when I, अगच्छति not go, इहस्थे stay here, धर्मात्मानौ righteous selves, महारथौ great warriors, तौ both, आशया with hope, धरिष्येते both will survive, मनस्विनः highsouled, वानराश्च vanaras also.

40012032.author: Translation
40012032.content: Both the highsouled warrior princes treading a righteous path as well as the vanaras will survive with a hope of my return if I stay back.

40012033.author: पदार्थः
40012033.content: जनकात्मजाम् Janaka's daughter, अदृष्ट्वा by not seeing, हस्तादानः food available to hand, मुखादानः and mouth, नियतः strictly, बहुमूलफलोदके filled with fruits roots and water, सागरानूपजे on the shore of the sea, देशे here, वृक्षमूलिकः surviving on roots of trees, वानप्रस्थः like a hermit, भविष्यामि I will be.

40012033.author: Translation
40012033.content: "If Janaki is not found I will stay here and live like a hermit subsisting on whatever is available on this sea shore, which has abundance of roots, fruits and water.

40012034.author: पदार्थः
40012034.content: जनकात्मजाम् Janaka's daughter, अदृष्ट्वा by not seeing, हस्तादानः food available to hand, मुखादानः and mouth, नियतः strictly, बहुमूलफलोदके filled with fruits roots and water, सागरानूपजे on the shore of the sea, देशे here, वृक्षमूलिकः surviving on roots of trees, वानप्रस्थः like a hermit, भविष्यामि I will be.

40012034.author: Translation
40012034.content: "If Janaki is not found I will stay here and live like a hermit subsisting on whatever is available on this sea shore, which has abundance of roots, fruits and water.

40012035.author: पदार्थः
40012035.content: चिताम् pyre, कृत्वा having made, समिद्धम् lit, अरणीसुतम् fire sticks (fire), प्रवेक्ष्यामि will enter, वा or else, उपविष्टस्य seated here, लिङ्गिनीम् starving, साधयिष्यतः fast unto death, शरीरम् body, वायसाः crows, श्वापदानि च wild beasts, भक्षयिष्यन्ति  will eat.

40012035.author: Translation
40012035.content: "I will prepare a pyre  and enter the fire  so that sea waves wash off the ashes or crows and beasts will eat up my body while i sit fasting unto death.

40012036.author: पदार्थः
40012036.content: इदम् this, महर्षिभिः by ascetics, दृष्टम्  seen, निर्याणम् ending of life, इति like this, मे my, मतिः thought, जानकीम् Janaki, न चेत्पश्यामि if I am not able to see, सम्यक् right, आपः water, प्रवेक्ष्यामि will enter.

40012036.author: Translation
40012036.content: "I shall enter water and drown myself to death if I am not able to find Janaki. I think this way of ending life has been suggested by great ascetics.

40012037.author: पदार्थः
40012037.content: सीताम् Sita, अपश्यतः I could not find, मम for me, चिररात्रीयं this long night, सुजातमूला started well, सुभगा lovely, यशस्विनी glorious one, कीर्तिमाला famous one, प्रभग्ना is wasted.

40012037.author: Translation
40012037.content: My glory which had a good start (in the form of bringing Rama to Sugriva) and brought fortune to Sugriva and fame to me has been snapped as I could not find Sita.

40012038.author: पदार्थः
40012038.content: नियतः strictly, वृक्षमूलिकः resting under the tree, तापसो वा or an ascetic, भविष्यामि I will remain, असितेक्षणाम् blackeyed, ताम् her, अदृष्टवा without seeing, इतः from here, न प्रतिगमिष्यामि I will not go back.

40012038.author: Translation
40012038.content: "I will remain an ascetic and do penance under the tree practising selfcontrol and not go back without seeing the blackeyed Sita.

40012039.author: पदार्थः
40012039.content: ताम् her, सीताम् Sita, अनधिगम्य without finding, इतः from this place, प्रतिगच्छामि यदि if I go back, सर्वैः by all, तै: by those, वानरैः सह along with vanaras, अङ्गदः Angada, न भविष्यति will not live.

40012039.author: Translation
40012039.content: "Besides, if I go back without finding Sita all the vanaras including Angada will die.

40012040.author: पदार्थः
40012040.content: विनाशे by comitting suicide, बहवः many, दोषाः sins, जीवन् by living, भद्राणि auspicious events, पश्यति can be experienced, तस्मात् therefore, प्राणान् life, धरिष्यामि I will sustain, जीवितसङ्गमः only a living person, ध्रुवः is certain

40012040.author: Translation
40012040.content: "If I commit suicide, I will earn numerous sins. By being alive, I can witness auspicious events. Therefore, I will live, for, happiness can come only to the living.

40012041.author: पदार्थः
40012041.content: कपिकुञ्जरः the elephant among monkeys, एवम् that way, बहुविधम् in many ways, दुःखम् grief, मुहुः over and over, मनसा in mind, धारयन् by holding, तदा then, शोकस्य sorrow, पारम् long, नाध्यगच्छात् did not reach of the end.

40012041.author: Translation
40012041.content: The elephant among monkeys (Hanuman) worrying over and over again, holding his head for long could not reach the end of his grief.

40012042.author: पदार्थः
40012042.content: वा or, दशग्रीवम् tenheaded one, महाबलम् endowed with great strength, रावणम् Ravana, वधिष्यामि I will, हृता dead, सीता Sita, कामम् अस्तु desire will be fulfilled, प्रत्याचीर्णम् fitting reply, भविष्यति will be.

40012042.author: Translation
40012042.content: "I will kill Ravana, this mighty, tenheaded demon. Sita was indeed carried away by him. This (killing him) can be a fitting reply to his evil action. My desire would be fulfilled.

40012043.author: पदार्थः
40012043.content: अथवा otherwise, एनम् him, सागरम् उपर्युपरि over the ocean, समुत्क्षिप्य by lifting across (like a sacrificial prey), पशुपतेः to lord Siva, पशुमिव like a bull, रामाय to Rama, उपहरिष्यामि I shall offer.

40012043.author: Translation
40012043.content: "Or else, I shall carry him across the sea and put him before Rama like a bull as if he is a sacrificial prey to lord Siva."

40012044.author: पदार्थः
40012044.content: वानरः vanara, ताम् her, सीताम् Sita, अनधिगम्य unable to find, इति thus, चिन्ताम् worry, समापन्नः distressed, ध्यानशोकपरीतात्मा whose mind was overcome with anxiety, चिन्तयामास started thinking further.

40012044.author: Translation
40012044.content: Distressed over his inability to find Sita, Hanuman's mind was overcome with anxiety and he started thinking further.

40012045.author: पदार्थः
40012045.content: रामपत्नीम् Rama's wife, यशस्विनीम् famed, सीताम् Sita, यावत् until, पश्यामि I see, तावत् till then, एताम् this, लङ्कां पुरीम् city of Lanka, पुनः पुनः again and again, विचिनोमि I will keep searching.

40012045.author: Translation
40012045.content: "Till I find the virtuous Sita, wife of Rama in this Lanka, I shall keep searching everywhere again and again.

40012046.author: पदार्थः
40012046.content: सम्पातिवचनात् on Sampati's words, अहम् I, रामम् Rama, आनयामि यदि if I had brought, राघवः Raghava, भार्याम् wife, अपश्यन् unable to see, सर्ववानरान् all vanaras, निर्दहेत् would have burnt.

40012046.author: Translation
40012046.content: "Had I brought Raghava following  the words of Sampati, Rama would have burnt all vanaras unable to find his wife.

40012047.author: पदार्थः
40012047.content: नियताहारः restricting food, नियतेन्द्रियः controlling senses, इहैव here itself, वत्स्यामि I will stay, मत्कृते for my fault, ते those, नरवानराः naras and vanaras, न विनश्येयुः will not perish.

40012047.author: Translation
40012047.content: "I will stay here itself, restricting my food and controlling my senses. Let not men and monkeys perish for my fault.

40012048.author: पदार्थः
40012048.content: महाद्रुमा huge trees, या such, इयम् this, अशोकवनिका Ashoka grove, दृश्यते is seen, इमाम् there, अधिगमिष्यामि I will go, इयम् here, मया by me, न विचिता हि not looked for.

40012048.author: Translation
40012048.content: "Here is the Ashoka grove with huge trees. I will go there. I have not looked for her in this place.

40012049.author: पदार्थः
40012049.content: वसून् Vasus, रुद्रान् Rudras, तथा likewise, आदित्यान् Adityas, अश्विनौ Aswinis, मरुतोऽपि च Maruts also, नमस्कृत्वा after offering salutations, रक्षसाम् of  demons, शोकवर्धनः increase grief, गमिष्यामि will go.

40012049.author: Translation
40012049.content: "I shall offer salutations to Vasus, Rudras Adityas and Aswinis and proceed to  increase (cause) the sorrow of the demons. (There are eight Vasus, eleven Rudras, twelve Adityas, two Ashwins and fortynine Windgods).

40012050.author: पदार्थः
40012050.content: सर्वान् all, राक्षसान् ogres, जित्वा तु having conquered, इक्ष्वाकुकुलनन्दिनीम् delight of Ikshvaku family, तपस्विने for the ascetic, सिद्धिं यथा an offering like, रामाय to Rama, सम्प्रदास्यामि I will offer.

40012050.author: Translation
40012050.content: "I will conquer all the ogres and pass them to Sita, the delight of the Ikshvaku family  as an offering and give Rama to her as the fruit of her austerities."

40012051.author: पदार्थः
40012051.content: महातेजाः brilliant, मारुतात्मजः son of the Windgod, सः हनुमान् Hanuman, चिन्तावग्रथितेन्द्रियः with senses overwhelmed by worries, मुहूर्तमिव for a while, ध्यात्वा after reflecting, उदतिष्ठत् got up.

40012051.author: Translation
40012051.content: The brilliant son of the Windgod, Hanuman, whose senses were overwhelmed with worries, regained his senses in a short while and got up.

40012052.author: पदार्थः
40012052.content: सलक्ष्मणाय along with Lakshmana, रामाय to Rama, नमः salutations, अस्तु I offer, देव्यै to the divine lady, तस्यै to her, जनकात्मजायै च to Janaka's daughter, रुद्रेन्द्रयमानिलेभ्यः to Rudra, Indra, Yama and Vayu, नमः salutations, अस्तु be, चन्द्रार्कमरुद्गणेभ्यः Sun, Moon and Marutas, नमः salutations, अस्तु I offer.

40012052.author: Translation
40012052.content: "My salutations to Lakshmana, Rama and divine daughter of Janaka. Salutations to Rudra, Indra, Yama and Vayu. Salutations to Sun, Moon and Maruts"

40012053.author: पदार्थः
40012053.content: स: मारुतिः that son of the Windgod, तेभ्यः to them, नमस्कृत्य having saluted, सुग्रीवाय च to Sugriva, सर्वाः all, दिशः quarters, समालोक्य looking at, अशोकवनिकाम् Ashoka grove, प्रति towards.

40012053.author: Translation
40012053.content: Having offered salutations to all gods as well as to Sugriva, he looked at all quarters and left for the Ashoka grove.

40012054.author: पदार्थः
40012054.content: मारुतात्मजः Hanuman, सः वानरः the vanara, मनसा in his mind, पूर्वम् earlier, शुभाम् auspicious, अशोकवनिकाम् grove of Ashoka, गत्वा after going, उत्तरम् again, चिन्तयामास started thinking.

40012054.author: Translation
40012054.content: Hanuman started thinking again about his task after reaching the auspicious Ashoka grove.

40012055.author: पदार्थः
40012055.content: शोकवनिका Ashoka grove, ध्रुवम् surely, रक्षोबहुला guarded by many demons, वनाकुला with trees, सर्वसंस्कारसंस्कृता carefully tended, पुण्या sacred, भविष्यति it will be.

40012055.author: Translation
40012055.content: 'This Ashoka grove filled with many trees, guarded by many demons is carefully tended. It must be sacred.

40012056.author: पदार्थः
40012056.content: अत्र there, विहिताः posted, रक्षिणश्च guards, पादपान् trees, नूनम् surely, रक्षन्ति they are protecting, सर्वात्मा all pervading, भगवानपि divinity also, नातिक्षोभम् not violent, प्रवाति वै is blowing, मया my, रामार्थे for Rama's sake, रावणस्य च and Ravana also, अयम् this, आत्मा my own self, संक्षिप्तः made small.

40012056.author: Translation
40012056.content: "The guards posted there are surely protecting the grove. The divinity  pervading all over me (the wind) must also have been controlled as it is also not blowing violently. I have turned my body small for Rama's cause and also to save myself from Ravana.

40012057.author: पदार्थः
40012057.content: सर्षिगणाः (स ऋषिगणा:) along with all sages, देवाः gods, इह here, मे to me, सिद्धिंम् success, संविधास्यन्ति will give, स्वयंभूः selfborn, भगवान् god, ब्रह्मा Brahma, देवाश्चैव and also gods, अग्निश्च and Fire, वायुश्च even Wind, वज्रभृत् Indra, the wielder of thunderbolt, पुरूहूतश्च Indra who is invoked several times in sacrifices, पाशहस्तः holding a rope, वरुणश्च Varuna too, तथैव च so also,सोमादित्यौ Moon and Sun, महात्मानौ all great, अश्विनौ च twin Aswinis also, मरुतः Maruts, शर्वः एव च lord Siva, मे to me, सिद्धिम् success, दिशन्तु many give, सर्वाणि all, भूतानि beings, यः whoever, भूतानाम् of creatures, प्रभु: lord, अन्ये other, ये those, अदृष्टाः not seen, पथि on the way, गोचराः creatures moving on earth, मम to me, सिद्धिम् success, दास्यन्ति will ordain.

40012057.author: Translation
40012057.content: May all sages, gods, the selfborn Brahma, Windgod, Indra, the wielder of thunderbolt whose name is invoked in sacrifices, Yama, who carries a rope, Varuna give success and Lord Siva help me. May the Sun, Moon, Aswinis  Marutas assist me. May the gods of the quarters and the lord of all beings help me to succeed. May those whom I could not see also bring success to me.

40012058.author: पदार्थः
40012058.content: सर्षिगणाः (स ऋषिगणा:) along with all sages, देवाः gods, इह here, मे to me, सिद्धिंम् success, संविधास्यन्ति will give, स्वयंभूः selfborn, भगवान् god, ब्रह्मा Brahma, देवाश्चैव and also gods, अग्निश्च and Fire, वायुश्च even Wind, वज्रभृत् Indra, the wielder of thunderbolt, पुरूहूतश्च Indra who is invoked several times in sacrifices, पाशहस्तः holding a rope, वरुणश्च Varuna too, तथैव च so also,सोमादित्यौ Moon and Sun, महात्मानौ all great, अश्विनौ च twin Aswinis also, मरुतः Maruts, शर्वः एव च lord Siva, मे to me, सिद्धिम् success, दिशन्तु many give, सर्वाणि all, भूतानि beings, यः whoever, भूतानाम् of creatures, प्रभु: lord, अन्ये other, ये those, अदृष्टाः not seen, पथि on the way, गोचराः creatures moving on earth, मम to me, सिद्धिम् success, दास्यन्ति will ordain.

40012058.author: Translation
40012058.content: May all sages, gods, the selfborn Brahma, Windgod, Indra, the wielder of thunderbolt whose name is invoked in sacrifices, Yama, who carries a rope, Varuna give success and Lord Siva help me. May the Sun, Moon, Aswinis  Marutas assist me. May the gods of the quarters and the lord of all beings help me to succeed. May those whom I could not see also bring success to me.

40012059.author: पदार्थः
40012059.content: सर्षिगणाः (स ऋषिगणा:) along with all sages, देवाः gods, इह here, मे to me, सिद्धिंम् success, संविधास्यन्ति will give, स्वयंभूः selfborn, भगवान् god, ब्रह्मा Brahma, देवाश्चैव and also gods, अग्निश्च and Fire, वायुश्च even Wind, वज्रभृत् Indra, the wielder of thunderbolt, पुरूहूतश्च Indra who is invoked several times in sacrifices, पाशहस्तः holding a rope, वरुणश्च Varuna too, तथैव च so also,सोमादित्यौ Moon and Sun, महात्मानौ all great, अश्विनौ च twin Aswinis also, मरुतः Maruts, शर्वः एव च lord Siva, मे to me, सिद्धिम् success, दिशन्तु many give, सर्वाणि all, भूतानि beings, यः whoever, भूतानाम् of creatures, प्रभु: lord, अन्ये other, ये those, अदृष्टाः not seen, पथि on the way, गोचराः creatures moving on earth, मम to me, सिद्धिम् success, दास्यन्ति will ordain.

40012059.author: Translation
40012059.content: May all sages, gods, the selfborn Brahma, Windgod, Indra, the wielder of thunderbolt whose name is invoked in sacrifices, Yama, who carries a rope, Varuna give success and Lord Siva help me. May the Sun, Moon, Aswinis  Marutas assist me. May the gods of the quarters and the lord of all beings help me to succeed. May those whom I could not see also bring success to me.

40012060.author: पदार्थः
40012060.content: सर्षिगणाः (स ऋषिगणा:) along with all sages, देवाः gods, इह here, मे to me, सिद्धिंम् success, संविधास्यन्ति will give, स्वयंभूः selfborn, भगवान् god, ब्रह्मा Brahma, देवाश्चैव and also gods, अग्निश्च and Fire, वायुश्च even Wind, वज्रभृत् Indra, the wielder of thunderbolt, पुरूहूतश्च Indra who is invoked several times in sacrifices, पाशहस्तः holding a rope, वरुणश्च Varuna too, तथैव च so also,सोमादित्यौ Moon and Sun, महात्मानौ all great, अश्विनौ च twin Aswinis also, मरुतः Maruts, शर्वः एव च lord Siva, मे to me, सिद्धिम् success, दिशन्तु many give, सर्वाणि all, भूतानि beings, यः whoever, भूतानाम् of creatures, प्रभु: lord, अन्ये other, ये those, अदृष्टाः not seen, पथि on the way, गोचराः creatures moving on earth, मम to me, सिद्धिम् success, दास्यन्ति will ordain.

40012060.author: Translation
40012060.content: May all sages, gods, the selfborn Brahma, Windgod, Indra, the wielder of thunderbolt whose name is invoked in sacrifices, Yama, who carries a rope, Varuna give success and Lord Siva help me. May the Sun, Moon, Aswinis  Marutas assist me. May the gods of the quarters and the lord of all beings help me to succeed. May those whom I could not see also bring success to me.

40012061.author: पदार्थः
40012061.content: उन्नसम् with high nose, पाण्डुरदन्तम् with white teeth, अव्रणम् with no wounds, शुचिस्मितम् with pleasing smile, पद्मपलाशलोचनम् eyes like lotus petals, प्रसन्नताराधिपतुल्यदर्शनम् who appears like the pleasant Moon, तत् that, तदार्यावदनम् beautiful face of the noble lady, अहम् I, कदा when, द्रक्ष्ये नु will I see.

40012061.author: Translation
40012061.content: 'Oh when and how would I behold that beautiful noble lady of stainless character, with a Moonlike face, prominent nose, white teeth, pleasant smile and with eyes like lotus petals?

40012062.author: पदार्थः
40012062.content: क्षुद्रेण by a mean one, पापेन by a sinner, नृशंसकर्मणा a man of cruel deeds, सुदारुणालङ्कृतवेषधारिणा endowed with a dreadful look, बलाभिभूता overpowered by force, तपस्विनी a suffering lady, सा that, अबला weak, अद्य now, मे my, दृष्टिपथे in the range of my view, कथं how, भवेत् नु will I.

40012062.author: Translation
40012062.content: "How will I set my eyes on that gentle, frail and suffering thing now, who has been abducted by that mean, cruel sinner of dreadful look?" इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे त्रयोदशस्सर्गः। Thus ends the thirteenth sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
